hero.title: Law 5189/2014
hero.description: In compliance with Law No. 5189/2014 «Establishing the mandatory provision of information on the use of public resources regarding remuneration and other payments assigned to public servants of the Republic of Paraguay».

info.title: Commitment to transparency
